approvals.title: Approvals & Delegate Manager
approvals.subtitle: Find every application or contract that has permission to spend tokens from your wallet, and revoke them with 1 click.
approvals.noApprovals: Great news! No active delegate permissions found in this wallet.
approvals.whyRevokeBody: When you approve a dApp to spend your tokens, it can keep that permission forever unless you revoke it. If that dApp gets hacked or turns malicious later, they can drain your approved tokens without asking.

scamLab.title: Scam Lab Sandbox
scamLab.subtitle: Safely create and test scam tokens vs clean tokens on Devnet. Understand the anatomy of real-world Solana drainers.
scamLab.createScamDesc: Creates a test token with active Freeze Authority, active Mint Authority, and Token-2022 Permanent Delegate.
scamLab.createSafeDesc: Creates a test token where all authorities are cleanly revoked and supply is strictly capped.
scamLab.learnTitle: Scam Anatomy Guide (Learn in Plain Language)
scamLab.learnFreezeDesc: Scammers let you buy tokens on a decentralized exchange, but as soon as you try to sell or transfer, they activate the freeze switch on your account. You are trapped forever.
scamLab.learnMintDesc: If the creator never revokes mint authority, they can print millions of new tokens for zero cost and dump them on liquidity pools, driving the price you paid straight to zero.
scamLab.learnDelegateDesc: A Token-2022 feature that allows a designated address to transfer or burn tokens from ANY holder's account without asking for their private key or signature.
